title: WGTech
description: Intelligence at the Edge, Integrated Without Compromise
long_description: Every day, WGTech redefines the possibilities of Edge AI. We deliver end-to-end products and solutions through complete vertical integration—from custom hardware architecture to our intelligent application software, WGDeepInsight. By owning the entire technology stack, we ensure unmatched performance, reliability, and adaptability for the world’s most demanding environments.

videos.title: An example of WGTech's capabilities
videos.description: This video showcases WG Tech’s AI-powered fall and falling detection system, designed to provide real-time safety monitoring and early intervention for senior citizens in care homes, hospitals, and residential environments. Using advanced pose estimation, movement trajectory analysis, and temporal deep learning, the system can detect both ongoing and completed fall events
